_about: T21: the Tiro day's own timings (prologue, ritual, bout intros, aftermath). Session pacing only, no combat number. The ritual's hold is teach.json offerHoldS (docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 3). A missing or bad file fails the day (BeginArc).
_prologueMaxS: Card T21: the first-launch prologue is 'a static placeholder tableau line for up to 10 s, skippable by palming the centre stone'.
_ritualLineS: How long Warden Septima's line stands before the offer line replaces it (one line at a time, docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 2). Placeholder pacing until the C2 cue sheet and its voice lines set the real length.
_ritualTimeoutS: Card T21: 'a soft timeout of 20 s continues anyway'. Counted from the start of the ritual, the same 20 s as the never-blocking stone choices (V2-ROADMAP row 14).
_introS: Each bout opens on one intro line on the dais rail while the opponents stand on the sand; the kernel steps only after it. Placeholder pacing for C2.
_aftermathTabletS: The aftermath first shows the tablet with its heading line, then the closing line (card T21: 'a greybox stone tablet ... then the closing placeholder line'). Palming the centre stone ends the day only once the closing line stands.
